sloka: अगस्त्य चरिताम् आशाम् दक्षिणाम् यम रक्षिताम् ।सहैभिर्वानरैमुख्यैरङ्गदप्रमुखैर्वयम् - यद्वा -सह एभिः वानरैः मुख्यैः अंगद प्रमुखैः वयम् ॥४-५२-७॥
transliteration: agastya caritām āśām dakṣiṇām yama rakṣitām ।sahaibhirvānaraimukhyairaṅgadapramukhairvayam - yadvā -saha ebhiḥ vānaraiḥ mukhyaiḥ aṁgada pramukhaiḥ vayam ॥4-52-7॥

translations.english: 'We along with the dreadful monkeys are sent with Angada as our chief to the southern direction, guarded by Yama and inhabited by sage Agasti. We are commanded to search Sita, princess of Videha and also the abode of the demon Ravana who assumes any form at his free will.
